title: HSK word with Myanmar learning content
description: One entry in a data/words/hsk{level}/hsk{level}-{from}-{to}.json batch file (each file is an array of these).

id.description: hsk{level}-{number from the official list, 4 digits}. Never changes once published.

pinyin.description: Pinyin with tone marks, copied from the official list. Several readings are separated by '/'.

pinyinNumbered.description: Generated from pinyin: syllables with tone numbers, 5 = neutral tone, ü written v. e.g. "ba4 ba5".

tones.description: Tone of each syllable of the first reading. 5 = neutral tone.

partOfSpeech.description: Main part(s) of speech. Copied by sync-words from the official syllabus (data/raw partOfSpeech) when it has one; written by hand only for the entries it leaves empty.

partOfSpeechMinor.description: Secondary uses the syllabus lists in （…）, e.g. 量、（名）. Copied by sync-words.

sense.description: 1, 2… when the syllabus lists the same word more than once with different meanings. Copied by sync-words.

alsoLevels.description: Other HSK levels whose list includes this word again. Copied by sync-words.

pronunciationTip.description: The Myanmar-letter sound hint in quotes plus only what is special (tone change, sounds Myanmar lacks). No tone descriptions or disclaimer: the page shows tone chips from `tones` and the reminder once. See docs/content-guide.md.

usageNote.description: May be empty for very simple words.

commonMistake.description: May be empty when there is nothing useful to say.

relatedWords.description: Simplified forms of related HSK words.

workbookRefs.description: Phase 2: ids of workbook exercises that use this word.

needsReview.description: Set when something in the source data itself is uncertain and must be checked against the official syllabus.

myanmarText.description: Non-empty text that contains Myanmar script (Unicode, never Zawgyi — checked by scripts/validate-data.mjs).

audioPath.description: Phase 3: path under public/, e.g. audio/hsk1/hsk1-0001.mp3. null until recorded.
